title: Man United Managers Since Ferguson: Pochettino Is No. 12 🔴 #shorts
description:
Manchester United have had 11 different managers, head coaches and caretakers since Sir Alex Ferguson retired in 2013: David Moyes, Ryan Giggs, Louis van Gaal, José Mourinho, Ole Gunnar Solskjær, Michael Carrick (twice), Ralf Rangnick, Erik ten Hag, Ruud van Nistelrooy, Ruben Amorim and Darren Fletcher. description:

title: Steelers vs Eagles: No Win in Philly Since 1965 😳 #NFL #shorts
description:
The Pittsburgh Steelers haven't won in Philadelphia since 1965, before the first Super Bowl. The Philadelphia Eagles have won the last 11 meetings there: four at Franklin Field from 4 December 1966, three at Veterans Stadium and four at Lincoln Financial Field. In 1943 the two teams merged for one season as the 'Steagles'. On Sunday (1pm ET) the 6–3 Steelers visit the 2–7 Eagles, who have lost seven straight.
